title: A local basis extends to a global finite free map near one point
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring, V an open of Spec R, N a finite locally free O_V-module, and x a point of V. There exist an open neighbourhood U of x in V, a natural number r, and a global morphism phi from the free O_V-module indexed by ULift (Fin r) to N whose restriction to U is an isomorphism. Only a neighbourhood of the chosen point is required; no global epimorphism is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0EKP, proof of (2) to (3), local denominator-clearing step underlying the cited ample global-generation result

proof.text: Use exists_restrict_iso_free_of_isFiniteLocallyFree to choose a finite free trivialization near x, as supplied by the finite-locally-free definition. Compose its inverse with restrictFreeIso to identify the restriction of the global free sheaf with N on U. Finite local freeness also implies quasi-coherence of N.

Apply exists_global_map_of_local_free_map to this local isomorphism viewed as a morphism. It gives W containing x, a global phi and an equality expressing its restriction as an automorphism, the restricted local map and the canonical restriction comparison isomorphisms. All four factors are isomorphisms, so the restriction of phi is an isomorphism.

Choose a Fintype instance for the finite index type I. Reindex the global free module by Equiv.ulift composed with the inverse of Fintype.equivFin I, using freeFunctor.mapIso. Precompose phi with the resulting isomorphism q. Functor.map_comp and preservation of isomorphisms give the required local IsIso instance at rank Fintype.card I. Empty I gives rank zero.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0EKP (2) to (3), global-generation input specialized to O_V; local trivialization followed by Tag 01PW morphism extension and finite reindexing

lean.statement:
theorem exists_free_map_isIso_near_of_isFiniteLocallyFree
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (V : (Spec (.of R)).Opens) (N : V.toScheme.Modules) [N.IsFiniteLocallyFree]
    (x : V.toScheme) :
    ∃ (U : V.toScheme.Opens), x ∈ U ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (φ : free (R := V.toScheme.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin r)) ⟶ N),
        IsIso ((restrictFunctor U.ι).map φ)
